purpose: Form NCLAT-9 is used to maintain a register for Special Leave Petitions or Appeals against the orders of the Appellate Tribunal to the Supreme Court.
when: Not stated in the Rules text
steps: Maintain a register in Form NCLAT-9 for Special Leave Petitions or Appeals against Appellate Tribunal orders to the Supreme Court.
Make necessary entries in the register promptly by the Judicial Branch.
Place the register for scrutiny by the Chairperson in the first week of every month.
checklist: Verify that the register is in Form NCLAT-9 format.
Check that necessary entries regarding Special Leave Petitions or Appeals to the Supreme Court are up to date.
Ensure the register is ready for scrutiny by the Chairperson in the first week of every month.
watch: The register must be placed for scrutiny by the Chairperson in the first week of every month.
